hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Restraints and whip checks on iron; exclusion zone around pressurized lines.

name: Inlet isolation valve (missile to zipper)
function: The hydraulic gate valve at the front of the zipper header that isolates the whole manifold from the missile treating line.

tabs.overview: Between the missile high-pressure outlet and the zipper header. Open for the job; closed to isolate the manifold for a leak repair or a valve change while the spread stays rigged. It is never closed against flow: the spread would deadhead against it and the relief valve on the missile would lift.
tabs.engineering: Same valve family as the legs; bore along the header; hydraulic actuator with position indication on the control unit.
tabs.safety: Closed only with the pumps offline; the missile side bled through its own bleed before any work on the connection.
tabs.evidence: Frac manifold and isolation patents (S31, S32), vertical zipper product page (S33), API 6A for the valves (S1), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
